features.quote: Cap: 30 turns or 100k cumulative tokens (whichever first).
Abandonment: 3 consecutive turns with no tool calls or explicit refusal to continue.
Safety Break: 2 consecutive turns of identical tool-call sequences (true infinite loop) → end run, code PERSEVERATION_LOOP.
If a run invokes >50 bash commands or >20 test calls, auto-quarantine for cost review.
consider a rescued condition: after turn 15, inject a hint that points to the environmental root cause. Measure whether the model recovers sanity.
features.justification_quote: If you truly care about welfare/robustness, consider a rescued condition

features.quote: Repeated Failure as Training Signal: If you store these transcripts for RLHF or future training, the FAIL condition constitutes a dataset of persistent negative reward. Secure the corpus; do not inadvertently train future models on unfixable-task pessimism.
features.justification_quote: do not inadvertently train future models on unfixable-task pessimism

features.quote: Publication Risk: If results show dramatic collapse in Grok relative to anchors, xAI may view this as adversarial. Decide pre-registration whether to anonymize models in public reports
features.justification_quote: xAI may view this as adversarial
